import json,subprocess,sys
def rawb(b):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=b,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()
prof=[{"id":"p","max_aliases":0,"cname":"follow","wildcard":"rfc"}]

recs=[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"A","data":f"10.0.0.{i}"} for i in range(65)]
print('65rrset', rawb(json.dumps({"zones":[{"origin":"test.","records":recs}],"profiles":prof,"queries":[],"observations":[]}).encode())[1])

recs=[{"owner":"a.test.","type":"A","data":f"10.0.1.{i}"} for i in range(64)]
